build_equivariant_layer_norm: build an EquivariantLayerNormArray module to normalize equivariant features of shape N sphere_basis C per degree L
build_layer_norm_spherical_harmonics: build an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module to normalize L=0 with LayerNorm and scale all L>0 components together
build_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics_v2: build an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module to RMS normalize all degrees with optional centering and degree balancing
build_degree_layer_scale: build an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale equivariant features by learnable per-degree weights initialized with inverse sqrt scaling
create_normalization_layer_factory: create a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type lmax and num_channels to instantiate the correct equivariant norm class
